name: Higgledy Hyde, RHS Garden Hyde Hall
description: Higgledy Hyde, an adventure play area for younger visitors tucked behind the Winter Garden, plus a children's play area marked on the garden map.
fee: Non-members pay to visit: adults from about £14 to £20 depending on garden and day, children 5–16 £5–£6, under-5s free. RHS members get in free (individual members can bring 2 children).
